finding: The study found that a high proportion of women who underwent appendectomy for acute appendicitis during pregnancy required cesarean section, and cesarean delivery may increase the likelihood of acute appendicitis and appendectomy in the early puerperium.
mod_finding: Half of the women who underwent appendectomy for acute appendicitis during pregnancy may require urgent cesarean section.
gest_age: Time of appendectomy during pregnancy (first, second, or third trimester) and gestational age at birth
